cases.summary: Version of Docker image - missing info
cases.description:
### Bug Description

Hello,
for some time you do not provide a version of the Docker image (docker inspect n8nio/n8n:latest), why?

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/10b45018-7868-44fc-a5a4-e0ee4ddbacdb)

I have automation for checking newer version n8n than my instance and now doesn’t work.

Regards

### To Reproduce

docker pull n8nio/n8n:latest
docker inspect n8nio/n8n:latest | grep org.opencontainers.image.version

### Expected behavior

Set version of n8n in Docker image as before.

### Operating System

Debian 10

### n8n Version

1.95.3

### Node.js Version

20.19.2

### Database

SQLite (default)

### Execution mode

main (default)

evidence.eventual_fix_title: fix(core): Add missing version label to docker image
evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
fix(core): Add missing version label to docker image

## Summary

> Build arguments declared in the global scope of a Dockerfile aren't automatically inherited into the build stages. They're only accessible in the global scope.

https://docs.docker.com/build/building/variables/
